top_signals.title: Second Ceuta Incursion Attempt Fails as Morocco, Spain Boost Security
top_signals.summary: Grassroots calls for a second incursion into Ceuta from Morocco fell flat over the weekend, with security tight and authorities turning back the relative handful who tried to make the move.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
